title: Доступ организации
main: Пригласить участника; назначить одну роль и при необходимости depot
alternative: Отозвать membership; следующий command запрещён
errors: Чужой org или depot -> 404/403
acceptance: Given A/B; When member A GET booking B; Then 404 и тело без PII. Revocation запрещает команды сразу после authoritative check, чтения ≤60 s.

title: Каталог и тариф
main: Создать model и rate в EUR minor units; заменить rate новым version
alternative: Deactivate model скрывает новые quotes, не ломает существующие
errors: Нулевая/отрицательная стоимость или inactive model -> 422
acceptance: Given rate 2500; When rate changes to 3000 after quote; Then existing quote uses 2500 until expiry.

title: Поиск доступности
main: Выбрать depot, start/end, quantity; фильтр категории, cursor pagination
alternative: Нет единиц -> empty state; Redis down -> SQL
errors: start>=end, quantity вне 1..5 ->422
acceptance: When 26 models with page limit 25; Then second cursor returns last item without duplicate. Availability never guarantees allocation.

title: Котировка
main: Quote expires after 15 min; days=ceil(duration/24h); quantity multiplied
alternative: Quote expired -> refresh with explicit consent if amount changes
errors: Вход содержит decimal money or negative duration ->422
acceptance: Given 25 h, qty2, rate2500, deposit10000 per unit; Then days2, rental10000, deposit20000, total authorization30000.

title: Временный резерв
main: Booking pending -> reserve command; Inventory holds exact assets 10 min
alternative: Недостаточно units -> rejected; no partial holds
errors: 100 concurrent commands contend -> one wins for qty1/one asset
acceptance: Given one asset; When 100 unique bookings overlap; Then exactly 1 hold, 99 rejections, zero overlapping active allocations.

title: Подтверждение аренды
main: HoldCreated -> authorize; Authorized -> commit; Committed -> confirmed
alternative: Transient faults leave pending/reconciling; customer sees status
errors: Expiry before commit -> release and void; never confirm expired hold
acceptance: Given authorization succeeds and allocation commits; Then one confirmed booking, one active allocation, one authorization; 10 duplicate events change none of these counts.

title: Идемпотентность команд
main: Store request hash and durable response per org+subject+route+key 24h
alternative: Same hash returns same resource/status; processing ->202
errors: Same key different body ->409 idempotency_mismatch
acceptance: When retry 20 times after response loss; Then one booking and one operation; tenant B may reuse same key independently.

title: Отмена до выдачи
prerequisites: F06; pending or confirmed, not handed over
main: Record cancellation intent under booking lock; saga releases allocation and voids authorization
alternative: Late authorized event triggers void even after cancellation
errors: Handover claimed or handed_over ->409 cannot_cancel
acceptance: When cancel races allocation commit; Then terminal cancelled eventually has no active allocation and net captured0; timeout alone is not cancelled completion.

title: Складская выдача
prerequisites: F06; same depot; now in pickup window start-1h..end
main: Claim handover atomically in Booking then Fulfillment records act
alternative: Lost response: query claim, resume same job, never release automatically
errors: Missing allocation, revoked operator, cancellation won ->409/403
acceptance: When cancel and handover claim race; Then exactly one wins. Double handover returns original act; different payload ->409.

title: Возврат и inspection
main: Record return once; condition good/damaged; Inventory releases or quarantines; Booking starts settlement
alternative: Offline dependencies -> queued event; partial returns excluded core
errors: Damage above deposit -> manual_review, no automatic extra debit
acceptance: When return event delivered 10 times; Then one report, one release, one settlement; damaged asset not bookable until repair.

title: Завершение оплаты
main: Capture rental+late+damage within authorized bound; remainder void; ledger persists
alternative: Provider unknown -> reconciling and operator alert
errors: Overdeposit total -> manual_review; never overcapture
acceptance: Given authorized15000, rental5000, late2500, damage1000; Then capture8500 and void remaining6500, captured-refunded=8500.

title: Возврат списанных средств
main: Reason mandatory; idempotent refund ≤ remaining captured; webhook verifies result
alternative: Timeout queries PSP before retry
errors: Customer role ->403; refund over remainder ->422
acceptance: When two concurrent full refunds; Then total refunded ≤ captured and one succeeds; second conflicts.

title: Ремонт
main: Create maintenance allocation for non-rented asset; complete repair explicitly
alternative: Future reservations conflict -> reject and show affected booking IDs for dispatcher
errors: Already handed_over ->409; cannot delete existing bookings
acceptance: When maintenance period overlaps a committed booking; Then409 and no maintenance insert; after successful repair new hold is permitted.

title: Уведомления и realtime
main: Durable notification, SSE with cursor, email sink retry
alternative: SSE disconnected -> reconnect then HTTP snapshot; email fail does not fail booking
errors: Cross-tenant SSE cursor ->404; unknown cursor -> fresh snapshot
acceptance: Given confirmed event duplicated; Then one UI notification; SSE reconnect recovers latest state; email failure leaves confirmed.

title: История и audit
main: Timeline with source event and correlation; auth decisions audit separately
alternative: Read projection lag displayed with updated_at
errors: Secrets, tokens, full email never written to telemetry
acceptance: When investigate failed booking; Then actor, before/after state, correlation and saga phase are recoverable; timeline rows unique by source event.

title: Обновление конкурирующих форм
main: If-Match version on modifications; 412 with refetch action
alternative: User reloads and explicitly repeats action
errors: Missing If-Match ->428; stale ->412
acceptance: When two forms edit same asset at v3; Then first creates v4, second412 and cannot overwrite.

title: Контракты и эволюция
main: Add optional field; provider and old consumer contract suite run
alternative: Breaking meaning -> v2 route/event, overlap deployments
errors: Required field removal or enum narrowing -> CI failure
acceptance: Given old consumer fixture; When optional field added; Then both deserialize; breaking fixture rejected before release.

title: Восстановление после сбоя
prerequisites: M08; broker and PSP faults injectable
main: Inspect saga and inbox/outbox; controlled DLQ replay retains event ID
alternative: Poison payload quarantined with original metadata
errors: Blindly mark success or new charge -> forbidden
acceptance: Given crash after DB commit before ACK; When restarted and replayed; Then one business effect and no lost transition.

title: Независимая поставка
main: Pipeline builds changed service + reverse contract dependents; deploy digest, smoke, rollback
alternative: Failed readiness -> old deployment remains
errors: Migration destructive in same release -> blocked
acceptance: When deploy Notification only; Then six core service digests stay unchanged; rollback restores prior image without DB loss.

title: Резервное копирование
main: Backup all owned stores and record cutover times; restore to isolated namespace; reconcile saga/provider
alternative: Unequal backup timestamps -> report and recovery queue
errors: Restore into active prod namespace -> forbidden
acceptance: When restore controlled checkpoint; Then known booking counts, ledger balance and allocation invariants match checkpoint; measured RTO≤30min and snapshot RPO≤24h.
